title: Product CSV row (logical shape)
description: Logical shape of one row in data/raw/products.csv after CSV parsing and numeric coercion. The file on disk stores every value as text, and fields containing commas, quotes or outer whitespace are quoted.

name.description: Display name. May have leading/trailing whitespace; casing is inconsistent.

categoryId.description: CAT-01..CAT-29, an empty string, or an unknown id such as CAT-99.

brandId.description: BR-001..BR-060, an empty string, or an unknown id such as BR-99.

price.description: USD shelf price. Documented anomalies include 0, negative values and six-figure values.

createdAt.description: ISO YYYY-MM-DD for most rows; MM/DD/YYYY for 35 rows.
